description: Surgical care in combat is not graded on a curve. The test is simple and unforgiving: Could a wounded soldier be saved? If so, did we save him?That standard is why the after-action review, or AAR, is so ingrained in military culture. Once an operation ended, everyone involved gathered to look back.
